d: Short, thinning ash-brown hair is styled in a receding hairline. Narrow, squinting eyes are hidden behind thick-rimmed white glasses, set into a face with a mature, middle-aged appearance. The build is stocky and solid, dressed in a white short-sleeved button-up shirt with a loose crimson necktie, charcoal grey trousers, and black dress shoes. Signature details include black straps around the upper arms, fingerless black gloves with bulky red and grey metallic wrist guards, and a charcoal grey suit jacket draped loosely off one shoulder.
